title: Fellowship for Advancing Science Journalism in Africa and the Middle East
about: Knight Science Journalism @MIT accepts applications for its 2027-28 Fellowship for Advancing Science Journalism in Africa and the Middle East, open to journalists based in those regions. The fellow is based in the Boston/Cambridge area from mid-August to December 2027. Applications close 9 January 2027.
requirements: Journalists based in Africa and the Middle East with at least three years' experience reporting on science, health or environmental issues in the region
Reporters, writers, editors, producers, illustrators, filmmakers or photojournalists in print, broadcast or digital media
Able to obtain a U.S. visa (typically J-1) for the fellowship period
